Archive source path argument: zippath is the unvalidated package_name-derived path just written by open(zippath, 'wb'); reading/extracting the archive at an escaped location is part of the same traversal chain (the write at sink-02 is the primary escape primitive).

Primary CWE-22 sink of this codebase: extraction destination unzippedpath is derived from package_name by string removesuffix (no path canonicalization, no base-dir containment), and the archive entry names from the downloaded PyPI artifact are not validated in this code version - for .tar.gz archives shutil.unpack_archive reaches tarfile.extractall without an extraction filter (Python 3.10+ baseline), so malicious entry names ('../...') escape the destination directory (zip-slip). For .zip/.egg/.whl downloads (labeled '.zip'), zipfile.extract normalizes unsafe member names, which limits the entry-name variant to tar archives.
